messages.subject: Caspian v Harburn — draft letter before action for review
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Draft letter before claim attached for your review before it goes to Harburn. It sets out the £669,000 debt and the loss-of-bargain claim (currently £744,300, to be firmed up), and asks for their documents under the Practice Direction. I propose sending tomorrow.

James
